{{Quote|Let's get all this scrap the magno-sweeper picked up on board, just in case.|[[Thea (Human)|Thea]]|<ref name="SW108" />}}
The '''magno-sweeper''' was a device used to detect scrap metal. The crew of the ''[[Wandering P'orp]]'' used a magno-sweeper on [[Centares/Legends|Centares]] to [[Scavenger/Legends|salvage]] [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] out of [[Rubyflame Lake]].
